english.title: Person fail to stop for constable - anticipation of violence

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: CRIMINAL JUSTICE AND PUBLIC ORDER ACT 1994

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to stop when required to do so by a constable in uniform exercising powers to stop and search under section 60 of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.
english.legislation: Contrary to Section 60(8)(a) of the Criminal Justice and Public Order Act 1994.
